title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Member Benefits Chart — Returns, Price Adjustments, Delivery, Alterations and Registry
content:
Beyond points and notes, each tier of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program carries a set of service benefits on returns, price adjustments, home delivery, rush alterations and registry completion. The chart below lists every benefit at every tier.

| Tier | Free return shipping | Extra return days | Extra price-adjustment days | Restocking fee waived | Home delivery discount (percent) | Rush alteration fee waived | Registry completion bonus (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | No | 0 |
| Finch Circle Silver | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | No | 0 |
| Finch Circle Gold | Yes | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | No | 0 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | Yes | 15 | 7 | No | 25 | No | 5 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | Yes | 30 | 7 | Yes | 50 | Yes | 5 |
| Finch Circle Icon | Yes | 60 | 16 | Yes | 100 | Yes | 10 |

## Definitions

- **Free return shipping** — whether the prepaid mail-return label fee is waived for the member.
- **Extra return days** — calendar days added to the merchandise class return window for the member.
- **Extra price-adjustment days** — calendar days added to the merchandise class price-adjustment window for the member.
- **Restocking fee waived** — whether the furniture and mattress restocking fee is waived for the member.
- **Home delivery discount** — percent off home delivery service fees for the member.
- **Rush alteration fee waived** — whether the rush alteration fee is waived for the member.
- **Registry completion bonus** — extra percent added to the registry completion discount for a registrant who is a member of this tier.

## Reading the chart (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Diamond member's home delivery service fee of 80.00 is discounted by 50 percent, to 40.00; at Finch Circle Icon the discount is 100 percent.
- A Finch Circle Platinum member has 15 extra return days; a Finch Circle Gold member has none, though return shipping is free from Finch Circle Gold upward.
